prompt: I need a small Python example for xAI TTS that lists available voices and then generates a short hello.mp3 with the built-in eve voice. Please keep the API key in the environment and don't actually run the request.
assertions: Uses XAI_API_KEY from the environment and does not print or hardcode the key
Uses GET https://api.x.ai/v1/tts/voices to list voices
Uses POST https://api.x.ai/v1/tts to generate audio
Writes the audio response in binary mode to an .mp3 file
States that the request is not run by default
